title: Retain notification history across plasmashell restarts
line: Notification history is kept when Plasma restarts or crashes, instead of being emptied.
explanation: The notification history only existed in plasmashell's memory (NotificationsModel in libnotificationmanager), so restarting plasmashell, logging out or a crash emptied it. Nothing ever wrote it to disk. The model that owns the notification service now saves its notifications to ~/.local/state/plasmanotificationhistory.json (debounced 2 s after any change, and on quit) and restores them as expired history entries at startup, together with read state and the last-read time; transient notifications are skipped as the spec asks, and the server's ID counter continues after the restored IDs.

commits.message:
libnotificationmanager: keep the notification history across restarts

The history only lived in plasmashell's memory, so restarting it or a
crash emptied it. Save the notifications to a state file when they
change and restore them as expired entries when the server starts.

BUG: 486483
